title: 纸是树做的
subtitle: 木头打成浆，再铺平压干
character: wearing a moss green t-shirt, brown trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, warm earthy gouache painting, soft rounded shapes with clean brown outlines, kraft brown, moss green and cream, visible brush texture, the illustration covers the entire image area

pages.zh:
我撕了一张纸，
边上毛毛的。
爸爸说，
那些毛毛的东西
是从树上来的。
pages.scene: The little boy holds a torn sheet of paper close to his face, looking at its fuzzy edge, curious.

pages.zh:
纸是木头做的。
树里有很多很细的丝，
叫纤维。
纸，
就是这些丝铺在一起压出来的。
pages.scene: One tree trunk cross-section on a cream background with many fine lines running from the centre outward. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
先把木头切成小块，
再加水，
搅成又稀又稠的糊。
这个糊叫「纸浆」，
看起来像米汤。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two containers side by side on a cream background: the left one holding square wood chips, the right one holding a smooth thick liquid. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
把纸浆倒在细网上，
水从网眼漏下去，
纤维留在上面，
薄薄地铺成一层。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one flat mesh screen on a cream background with a thin layer on top and several drops falling through it from below. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
再用滚筒压，
把水挤出来，
然后烘干。
一张纸
就这样做好了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three stages in a row on a cream background: a wet layer, the same layer under a roller, and a flat dry sheet. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
纸有厚有薄。
抽纸软软的，
纸箱硬硬的，
照片纸滑滑的。
都是纤维铺法不一样。
pages.scene: Three sheets in a row on a cream background: one soft and crumpled, one thick and corrugated at the edge, one smooth and flat. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
用过的纸还能再做纸。
把旧纸泡开，
重新搅成浆，
再铺一次、压一次，
就又是新纸了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one circular loop of arrows on a cream background with three small symbols around it: a sheet of paper, a container of pulp, and a new sheet. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
不过纤维每回收一次
就短一点。
所以回收纸
一般用来做纸箱、
做包装，不做书。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three groups of short lines on a cream background, the lines in each group shorter than in the one before. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
做纸要用很多树，
也要用很多水。
所以纸别浪费。
两面都写，
用完再回收。
pages.scene: One sheet of paper on a cream background with writing marks on both a front and a back panel, shown side by side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
现在很多纸
来自专门种的林子。
砍一棵，
就补种一棵，
林子不会变少。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rows on a cream background: the top row with five trees and one of them marked as cut, the bottom row with five trees and one small new sapling. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有些东西不用纸也行。
看电子书、
用布袋子、
手帕代替抽纸。
能少用一点，就少用一点。
pages.scene: Three small objects in a row on a cream background: a cloth bag, a folded handkerchief, and a flat rectangular screen. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把写满的纸翻过来，
在背面又画了一张画。
画完再放进回收箱。
它还会变成
另一张纸。
pages.scene: The little boy turns a used sheet of paper over and draws on the back of it at a table, content.
